operator_acceptance: ok lets record that as our new tool setter system

equipment.name: BTER CNC normally closed tool setter
equipment.contact_input: Mesa IN0, normalized NC open = contact
equipment.overtravel_input: Mesa IN2, normalized NC open = overtravel

reference.reference_surface: Machine plate at the recorded plate sample site
reference.height_formula: median(setter-top XYZ-probe trigger Z) - median(plate XYZ-probe trigger Z) - nominal setter pretravel
reference.pretravel_basis: SOURCE-VERIFIED nominal design value, accepted by the user; not a direct IN0 switch-height measurement

measurement_frame.capture: Mesa IN1 rising-edge servo sample; not a hardware trigger latch or a post-stop position
measurement_frame.x_directions: physical RIGHT / LinuxCNC -X; physical LEFT / LinuxCNC +X
measurement_frame.probe_setup: USER-OBSERVED ACTUAL: same XYZ probe, unchanged clamping depth and homed coordinate reference
measurement_frame.offset_cancellation: The unchanged probe/tool offset cancels in the Z difference; no additional ball-radius term is applied

setter_top_sample.location_meaning: Measured top contact point; the setter center has not been measured

evidence.selection: All recorded touches retained; median used for each surface; no rejected touches
evidence.recording_state: No cycle gaps or recorded transport/controller faults; all positions valid and homed

scope.height: Accepted reference from the two sampled sites; no flat plate plane is inferred

runtime_reference.meaning: INI is the shared program configuration; this JSON and the archived recordings retain the accepted calibration evidence

legacy_puck.status: Superseded as the current tool-setter reference; historical calibration evidence only
legacy_puck.program_status: The existing contact, single-touch and double-touch entry points now use the BTER NC circuits and shared TOOL_SETTER calibration; filenames and catalog IDs are retained for compatibility
